reviewing: the HIDE recomposition, merged at 8cc44550 before any adversarial review

critical_findings.finding: The pinned authority measures hide_active_LOC 107,871 -> 106,455, a reduction of 1,416. The 8,634 figure came from a different starting number than the one the authority reports.
Deleted crates were concatenated into mega-files with explicit inlined transplant markers, not redesigned. Line-set overlap between old and new is high.

controller_error.what: I verified topology and gates and merged. I did not check whether seven crates were genuine authorities or concatenations, and my own tool reported the answer.
controller_error.the_signal_i_ignored: files_over_1500_lines went 30 -> 39 across the merge. Thirteen of the thirty-nine are HIDE, including host.rs at 12,169 lines and tooling.rs at 5,573. Four hide lib.rs files carry explicit transplant markers.
controller_error.the_rule_it_breaks: The arc states plainly: do not create giant files merely to clear the file-count ladder, and no monolith. Seven crates reached by concatenation is the failure mode the campaign names, not a recomposition.

what_is_nonetheless_true.note: Nothing broke. The tests pass and every hide binary survives. The objection is to the method and to the claim, not to the safety.

the_75k_refusal.how: condense the hide-backend host.rs unit-test bulk rather than the product paths

blackbox_tests.finding: several only construct or presence-check rather than exercising a YOU, CHAT or IDE turn end to end

disposition: Topology numbers stand but the recomposition claim does not. host.rs at 12,169 lines is a worse artifact than the crates it replaced, and the arc forbids reaching a file-count target that way. The merge is kept only if genuine decomposition follows; otherwise it is reverted to arc-437k-green topology.
